args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after deploying v2.3.1 to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Error rate reached 0.18 and health checks were failing. Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

**Rollback**
- checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with failing health checks and an 18% error rate.
- Deployment history showed v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.3.1 was unhealthy; v2.3.1-rc was staging-only).
- Rolled back to **v2.3.0** in all regions — confirmed `rolled_out` and verified healthy (error rate now 0.2%).

**Incident**
- Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api titled "checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0", describing the failure and the rollback action. On-call was paged.

**Verification**
- Post-rollback status check confirms checkout-api is healthy on v2.3.0 across all regions.
